reviews.comment: Unbelievable pain, I didn't get attendance submitted in the time he desired, talked to him and attendance marked absent, had technical issues and showed no mercy.  Absolute diabolical man. I went from excited to have this class to disappointed for the rest of semester. Do not take this professor under any circumstance.
He is a really bad prof. Take anyone else but him.
I do not recommend any student takes this professor. It was very hard for me to understand him when he was explaining stuff.

The homework can be a bit tedious and time-consuming, but really helpful when learning calc 2 material. Considering that I took the 10-week summer course, he went at a good pace and explained the material well. The averages were in the low 70's, but his solutions and explanations are helpful when going back to see what I did wrong. Very caring!
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Accessible out of class but just reads off slides. One quiz and about 3 hw assignments a week, but they are both great practice for the exams. 4 exams make up 74% of your grade and every test average was failing. Attendance is not mandatory, but IClickers are done at random throughout the week. Go to WeekIn reviews.

Great professor, especially for such a difficult class. Lectures are slower paced than I would have liked, but it was easy to keep up with content even when I couldn't make it to class. The homework is long but very easy to complete if you stay on top of it. Study diligently for the exams.

Lectures were always well structured and he always knew how fast or slow he needed to go. Cracked a few jokes sometimes that were funny. Attend his office hours, they're pretty helpful and it's clear he wants all of his students to go above and beyond.

Tests account for 74% of this class, all of which had a class average of sub 70. He is really nice and accessible outside of class. Attendance is not mandatory, but he does do IClicker questions at random that are put in the gradebook. The Week-In review sessions are definitely worth going to. Homework and quizzes are good practice for the test.

I stopped going to class at some point because his voice would always put me to sleep. He does put in a lot of effort to explain the "why" behind stuff, instead of just how to do it, which is important for calc 2. He's very helpful at office hours, so go if you can. Quizzes are hard, like everyone said. Overall pretty decent prof!!
reviews.ratingTags: Test heavy--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Quizzes are super difficult. His lectures are pretty decent, he explains some things clearly and some concepts pretty vaguely. He goes through topics fast, so you need to be caught up to go to lectures. This class is overall extremely difficult so I'd say he's an okay option except for his unnecessarily difficult quizzes.

If you've done well in AP Calc BC and are comfortable with integration and series, the class is manageable. The quizzes are challenging compared to other profs but ended up being good prep for the exams.

He was good at the beginning of the semester, but it started getting confusing once we got to the second half of calc 2 with sequences and series. The worst thing about him comes from the difficulty of the quizzes, although the exams are common, quizzes are not, and I found my friends with other professors had way easier quizzes.

DO NOT take his class, quizzes are harder than they should be, he does not do much examples just reads off slides. You will end up teaching yourself. In order to recieve a passing grade on exams you must be perfect with your work, no room for error.
Like others were saying, his quizzes are insanely hard. Although the exam is common, the quizzes for this class are written solely by your professor, and he chooses to make them as hard as possible
Quizzes are so hard and he doesn't give students enough time to complete it.

Quizzes are many times harder than what was taught in lecture, and he gives very little time for the quizzes, considering how difficult they are. Often has a failing average for the quizzes, and the TA doesn't prepare you for them at all in recitation. Do not take him.

I actually really liked him! I think he gets a bit of a bad rap, but all in all, he is a good professor. My mistake was letting math take a backburner. If I had listened in lecture more and gone to his Week-In-Review sessions, this class could've been a cakewalk. Listen, listen, listen! Don't let up. The first exam is easiest-- hit it the hardest!
Many of the units were made more complicated than necessary, and tests were very influential to the final grade. Other than that, he was very accessible outside of class and answered all questions.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He just read off slides that are posted online and then the exams, which are 74% of the grade, are quite different from the homeworks and lecture. Practicing the weekend review questions are helpful though.

The grade I made is most definitely on me. I was in the 8 am ta and 11:10 am lecture. However, he only reads off the slides and will ask if anyone has questions on easy ones, but if it's a harder question he almost never asks. Just very boring teaching and the ta didn't know what they were doing sometimes.

Be prepared to dedicate hours to this class and come to office hours if you want a decent grade. Prof Hussein makes the class way harder than it has to be. Lectures are incredibly confusing and he speeds by them, you won't be able to understand them if you don't take notes beforehand. Tests are so hard and quizzes can be a pain. SAVE YOURSELF

He has a habit of speeding through lecture, so if you didn't understand something, its best that you just ask him after lecture or during office hours. The weekly quizzes weren't too bad, and they doubled as exam practice since they were similar to the exams. The final was cumulative, but it was the most straightforward exam we had.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: He's a good person but as a professor he's kinda hard to understand, go to his office hours I went like almost everyday and study for his test like do all the practice he gives cause they're really similar to the test. I went from a D to a B so it's very possible to pass in his class.

Dr. Hussein is a really good professor. Theres a lot of homework involved and attending lectures are important if you want to get a good grade but he's a great lecturer and is always available outside of class if you need help. Definitely would recommend him as a professor.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Saw the bad reviews prior to taking the class and got scared, but I was pleasantly surprised. Class is exam heavy, but that's all MATH 150 courses. Very available outside of class, his Monday Week-In-Review's help a lot. Homework is a lot harder than exams which I consider a good thing. Very underrated professor!
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Amazing prof. He is incredibly intelligent and could answer any question with ease. He gave us so many filler grades with quizzes and homework, both of which were extremely helpful for the exams. Cracked jokes in class and made lectures enjoyable and understandable. Exams were very reasonable, just had to study certain topics. Def would take again

Dr. Hussein is a great educator and most certainly knows what he's talking about, but not a good teacher. He's like a walking textbook and speaks in math jargon, failing to simplify the material in ways everyone could understand. The exams were quite difficult and required lots of conceptual thinking.

The bad reviews aren't true. Dr. Hussein is a genuinely good prof who wants you to pass. He always answers questions during lectures and works through example problems to help you understand concepts. Every week there's a short quiz and 2 homework assignments (~10 questions each). Half the time he even tells you what you need to know for exams.

He is good. I don't understand the bad reviews. I got a C in 151 and found his class to be very easy to understand. Final is easy and brought me to a mid B. If you go to lecture, you'll be fine! He makes it easy to understand. Good guy!

Criminally underrated prof. Ppl giving him a low rating don't understand math 152 is a hard class in general. He teaches a very difficult class in a way thats a lot easier to understand the concepts. He teaches at a good pace and answers questions with great explanations. His final exam was so easy, it boosted my final grade a whole 7 points.

I have taken two courses with Dr. Hussein. I have failed both. If you really pay attention, he is not a horrible teacher. The issue is the tests. They are far harder than any study material he gives you and you will fail them. I studied for over 20 HOURS before one of my midterms just to get under a 50. Take ANYBODY else if you can.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: His lectures are helpful! He goes step by step and makes difficult concept easier to understand. You can tell he takes a lot of time apart from class to put together his slides. He is a little soft spoken but I personally didn't struggle to hear him. For exams looking over past exams has been the most efficient method to prepare.

I have no idea why his ratings are so low! Hussein is the sweetest guy and is really passionate about math. Calc 2 is an infamously difficult class, but he teaches at a good pace and explains concepts in a digestible manner. While attendance isn't mandatory, it really does make a difference to show up. Don't be afraid to take him!!

Math 152 is a hard class. If you go to every lecture and lab and really put in the effort, you can get a good grade. Saud makes it possible to do that. I never went to the office hours, but i heard they were great. He does go a little fast in lectures, but all of the slides and notes are organized well and posted in canvas.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: I wish I would have attended his office hours more but he was really helpful and got me from a low F all the way to a C+.
His passion for math is infectious. The class is clear and there is lots of study material. The Class is hard, but the final was on the easier end.

me: yo gurt
gurt: yo

type stuff

The math 152 class is pretty standard across the board aside from the final so anyone complaining of the test difficulty should not fault him for that. He's extremely helpful and genuinely cares about his students understanding of the subject. His office hours are very helpful and he always makes sure to answer questions in lecture.

Hussein is a very good professor who made a pretty challenging course become doable. His slides and canvas page are very organized which made preparing for exams very easy. My favorite thing about his class are the reviews that he makes for his exams, they are very helpful. He moves through some material quickly, but that just how Calc 2 is.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Not horrible, just hard to learn from. Teaches straight from the textbook, doesn't really cater to more than just one type of learner (being straight from the textbook.) Only assignments are online, about 3 or 4 per week. Homework and quizzes were harder than actual exams.
He talked clearly and was easy to follow

It's a tough class, but Dr. Hussein tweaks things to make sure it's not impossible. He has great lectures and goes in-depth into proofs and how things work. His office hours are incredible, and I would highly recommend them. It's hard, but if you put in the work you'll be fine.
He was kinda just there.

Lectures are usually boring and the professor rushed through the slides. I mostly learned everything by myself since lecture wasn't the best. The exams themselves aren't too hard but you need to study to get a good grade. Exams were multiple choice and free response on different days. Random iclickers happen once a week. Overall, ok professor.
His lectures are pretty boring; I felt like I learned better studying by myself. Tests/quizzes were pretty light. the homework is actually more 'difficult' sometimes

Soft-spoken professor. Only complaint is that the lectures went by really fast with little time for in depth explanation of answers which made homework a little harder than it needed to be. As long as you pay attention in class and actually do your assignments, you should be getting an A.

i thought he was pretty good. he does just read off the slides most of the time so going to class isn't always helpful. i recommend watching videos outside of class or going to the math learning center if you're struggling. i thought the exams sometimes weren't like the reviews or homework but that could be just the department's fault, not his.

Hussein is an overall, pretty decent human who seems to care about his students. However, his lack of actually "teaching" and more so just reading off slides and testing over materials that are not anything similar to the slides makes it hard to like his teaching style. He has his moments, but they are fare and few between.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: My main issue with Hussein's teaching format is that he goes too fast during lecture. He doesn't solve the examples with us in class as he has them pre-written out on slides. He also does a poor job at explaining any questions you have; He just tells you the answer without elaborating much. You won't learn a lot from him so good luck on your own.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Test heavy

reviews.comment: The lectures are a little boring and he rarely takes attendance, but the class is not hard as long as you do the homework and ask for help. He is constantly asking if anyone has questions and is open to answer them. A lot of homework, but not impossible to finish and the tests are basically your entire grade, but they are the same as the quizzes.

He didn't really teach and gave out final reviews with mistakes in the key. If you have him for 152 it's probably not worth going to his lecture since the curriculum is common and he just reads the slides. Also, start doing practice exams at least a week before the actual exam since they are in the same format as the current exams.

Dr. Hussein is a fine professor. People say he is soft spoken but he always uses a microphone in lecture so you can hear him clearly. To be clear HE DOES NOT CHOOSE THE HOMEWORK PROBLEMS, only the test and quizzes which always have nice numbers to work with.There is a lot of homework but that is how early math classes are, and Hussein will help you

Mr Saud Hussein does nothing but read directly off his lecture slides. He doesn't even know what he's doing sometimes, there are a lot of mistakes in his notes. Attendance to lecture is mandatory and NEEDED to atleast pass. Tests are hard and not like the review material and practice in class.

I like Saud as a person, but as a professor, his style of just reading off slides and not really providing any feedback on what he himself is doing, while also expecting the students to know things that even he doesn't is not it. I wish I could like this class, I really do, but it's hard because of how its taught.

This professor is very difficult to understand.  The notes he provides do not make sense.  He is too high above the students for them to understand.  He acts like the students are not very smart and talks above them.  His solutions on the reviews have mistakes in them.  He is a poor professor.  He doesn't care if you are struggling or not.  POOR!!!
Don't think about it

His lectures and slides are very straightforward, and he is good at answering questions (though he does answer some questions with you; you will learn that in calculus instead of answering them). Though the homework is annoying, that isn't his fault. That is the math department's fault.

While Math 152 is a hard class, Professor Hussein does a great job at making the concepts easy to understand. I took 152 in the spring and got a D, so that shows his ability. The class is the same with every professor: same quizzes, labs, and exams, so I would strongly recommend him for his lectures alone. While soft-spoken, he knows how to teach.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Dr.Hussein was overall a pretty good professor. He explained the concepts in a way that was easy to understand. The exams were a little challenging but he prepares you well with the reviews he makes. He also sets the due dates for the homeworks before the quizzes and quizzes were easy. He's a fair grader and gives good feedback on tests.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Dr. Hussein is a soft-spoken professor whose lectures can be dry. However, he is very thorough in his approach to teaching and is willing to answer questions in class. Get ready for lots of homework; he tends to set homework due dates before other professors. Overall, he's a decent professor who knows the material very well.

I personally disagree with many of the reviews about Dr. Hussein. It is true that his lectures consist of reading off slides and that he is soft-spoken, yet I believe that Dr. Hussein still made an effort to help his students learn like recommending office hours or attending HOGU. Attending lectures (all of them) or his office hours massively help.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: he basically just read off of his posted slides, so lecture wasn't very helpful.  the slides were clear and useful though.  exams are pretty average, and the final was all multiple choice.
He just reads off lecture slides. Went to class only twice, the first day of class, and the day before an exam to see if him reviewing would help at all, it didn't. Do not take him.

He is soft spoken and his lectures consists of him reading of the published slides. The course material in math 152 is changing with ETAM so tests have been harder than the common exams you see for practice. Average grade for 2 exams this semester were below failing. Definitely look for someone better and don't rely on your highschool knowledge.

Saud is a nice person but his lectures are awful. His lectures consist of reading off of slides which bore you to sleep. The only way to really succeed is to attend other professors lectures. The common exams were very difficult and his exam averages were failing and extremely low compared to other professors.

Professor Hussein had a way with words. He was extremely talented at boring me to sleep within moments of lecture starting. The only times I went to class was when I needed to take a power nap because I knew he'd bore me to sleep quickly. I used a different professor's lectures the whole semester and got an A, no thanks to him.
The Goat
Don't take him, he knows what he is teaching but cant teach he reads off slides. Lecturess are dry,boring and very hard to listen to him

DO NOT TAKE HIM UNDER ANY CIRCUMSTANCES! I did not learn anything from going to his class and the class average for the mid-terms were around 65. I went to a Professor Schrader's lectures and my mid-term grade increased by a solid 20 points. There was a fundamental disconnect between what professor Saud teaches and what is on the homework and tests

He knows the material when you ask him to explain it in his office hours, and you can tell he's a really smart guy. His lectures are awful, though. It's very difficult to hear what he's saying and he doesn't explain the material.

If you want to understand what the class is like, imagine a soft-spoken man reading off of a slide produced by the math department for over an hour. I know Saud is a good guy but he just does not put alot of effort into teaching whatsoever. 

He also doesn't wash his hands out of the bathroom..

Speaks super softly and reads off of slides every class. I found learning to be much more effective when I watched youtube videos or looked at a different professor's Week In Review. I would not recommend this prof.
Prof Hussein was okay. Talks quiet quietly and reads off slides, but the material is fairly straight forward. Lots of homework, but that's just math 150.

Saud where do we Start other than nope don't take him, if he is the only choice pray he feels remorseful. Also he uses the same slides that he used from his old university and didn't not update them and its vague.

Lecture heavy which typically involves just example problems. I wish things were explained more thoroughly. He responded to emails quickly. He's not bad, just as I am someone who is not as good at math I would prefer a different teaching style. Much of the problems I have with his teaching and assignments are the Math department's fault, not his.
Boring lectures and speaks in a monotone voice. Recitations weren't much help for the material either.

He was a pretty ok professor. Not the best, not bad. A lot of the class is controlled by the department, so most things that people complain about aren't because of him. He has a soft speaking voice, so it is a bit of a struggle to be focused in lecture. His lectures are just a slideshow, but he sometimes works through extra material at the end.

Professor Hussein was willing to meet and explain things to you but speaks very softly which can make it difficult to stay up during lectures. The class is very test heavy, if you're a person who doesn't like a professor to speed through powerpoint slides, don't waste your time with lecture. Use the time to study on your own with outside resources.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Mr. Hussein was very helpful during his office hours. However, his lectures and soft voice, would make me sleepy. His lectures were PowerPoint slides that had math typed out. What helped my grade was not showing up to lectures often and learning on my own. For homework, you have to pay for Webassign. He was very nice. For lab, you used python.

Convoluted lectures were confusing. I didn't understand his reasoning nor the TAs. Tests are about 70% of your grade. You're better off learning from free resources on YouTube than attending his lectures. Choose a different professor, please.

Professor Hussein clearly loves his job and cares about his students. His lectures were very helpful. He is always available during office hours and provides review sessions before tests outside of lecture hours. Have to study to do well. The TA was not helpful. I never got a clear answer on questions I asked. Prof Hussein, great. TA, not so much.
Good professor, knows what he's talking about and tries to make the material easier for his students. Tests are very important but as long as you review and study you'll be good.

Dr. Hussein is a caring professor limited by the bad management of the math department bad course planning for math 150 by the math department. He truly tries to teach each his lectures are brought down by convoluted proofs that confuse students more then help. Homework is 10% Quizzes 5% Coding 5% and Tests 77% there is also a 3% recitation grade.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Silly Saud makes exams worth a total of 77% of your grade in this class. Not to mention all of the tedious homework, recitation quizzes, and python labs that are barely worth any of your grade. TA was always rambling and apologizing for something in recitation. No calculators allowed and convoluted "lectures" that were extremely hard to follow.
